instructions.content: NEVER mix Node.js fs calls into Bun-native file workflows; use `await Bun.file(path).text()`
NEVER run `npm install` in Bun-managed repositories; use `bun install`
NEVER interpolate untrusted input into SQL strings; bind values with prepared statements
NEVER pass unescaped user input into shell commands; use direct API calls or fixed command arguments
NEVER leave raw interpolated `query(` calls in existing code once flagged; refactor each to `db.prepare(...)` with bound parameters before merging
NEVER ignore a lockfile merge conflict when `bun install` fails; resolve `bun.lock`/`bun.lockb` conflicts and re-run `bun install`
NEVER skip `bun test` after changing dependencies; run it to isolate regressions before proceeding
NEVER keep going after a failed validation; revert the last change, confirm the error, then address the specific failure before re-validating
NEVER finalise a change without running the anti-pattern checks
NEVER record a decision without linking the exact references used
Confirm Bun is available (`bun --version`) and lock the dependency strategy before starting
Choose the category (runtime, file I/O, testing, sqlite, package, security) before implementing
Implement with the copy/paste commands from Quick Commands
Validate SQL with `rg -n "query\(|prepare\(" src`; queries on user-controlled input must use prepared statements
Use `Bun.serve` as the HTTP service primitive
Write tests with `bun test` and the `bun:test` module
Do not apply the skill when the project standard runtime is strictly Node.js with no Bun support
